interfaces.name: head_shell_screws
interfaces.what: the clearance side of the three head-closing screws: Ø2.6950 x 2.0040 at (x, y) = (0.0000, 49.5000), (39.0000, -49.5000), (-39.0000, -49.5000), axis z, centres z 1.9980 (span z 0.9960..3.0000), fit residual 0.0030 mm at 352.5 deg. The two FRONT positions add a Ø6.9020 x 3.1450 boss (centres z 1.4345) with a Ø5.5000 x 2.8240 driver bore below the clearance (centres z -0.4160), so the screwdriver reaches through the shell. The same three (x, y) carry part:microduck-top-head-shell 'shell_screws' Ø2.1000 pilots, measured independently on the other mesh — the two patterns agree exactly, on a Ø112.1175 circle.
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's bottom_head_shell.stl by cecad.meshfeatures.cylinders and the mesh bbox, frozen 2026-09-02 by tools/measure_mesh_features.py into out/laneT/features/bottom_head_shell.json (lane T); the MJCF places this mesh in body 'jaw_soft' at world [26.1, -0.0, 231.3146] mm, quat (wxyz) [0.707107, 0.0, 0.0, 0.707107] (ce-assemblies/microduck/current/placements.json)

interfaces.name: motor_support_screws
interfaces.what: the four screws that hang the motor support inside the head: Ø2.2000 x 9.3000 (one 9.2160) pilots at (x, y) = (-30.0000, 23.0000), (9.3500, -23.0000), (-30.0000, -16.0000) and (19.0000, 19.5000), axis z, centres z -5.1500 (span z -9.8000..-0.5000), each under a Ø2.7900-2.7910 x 0.7010-0.7040 counterbore centred z -0.1500 (span z -0.5000..0.2000). These four (x, y) are EXACTLY the four Ø2.7000 x 1.7000 through-holes measured independently on motor_support.stl (part:microduck-motor-support 'base_screws'). Ø2.2 pilot against a Ø2.7 clearance: loose for M2, plausible M2.5 — connection:threaded-m2 grades it.
